# Medex Supply

> > Medex Supply is a comprehensive online medical supply store offering hospital-grade equipment, surgical supplies, and healthcare products from leading manufacturers like 3M, Bair Hugger, and Coban.

Medex Supply provides medical professionals and healthcare facilities with a wide range of products including infection control solutions, patient warming systems, diagnostic tools, defibrillators, and homecare equipment. The store specializes in quality medical supplies from trusted brands for both clinical and home healthcare settings.
